name: Happy Forgings Limited
summary: Happy Forgings Limited, established in Ludhiana in 1979, makes forged and precision-machined components for heavy-duty uses. Its range includes engine and transmission parts such as crankshafts, connecting rods and differential cases, chassis parts like axle beams and steering knuckles, and items from bicycle pedals to valve bodies. Customers include makers of heavy commercial vehicles and agricultural machinery.
